Hi Sujata / AP team,

Thanks again for signing the order. We received PO 4589 today. To keep our bookings recognition and invoicing aligned, I wanted to map the few gating items and confirm dates so finance can lock the month. High level ask: can you confirm the estimated PO acceptance date (internal signoff) and the expected delivery/listing of the service (SaaS onboarding complete)?

Proposed gating map from our side:
- PO received (we have the scanned PO) — today
- PO validated by Acme AP (you) — needed for invoice creation
- Implementation milestone (onboarding complete) — triggers bookings recognition window
- Invoice issue date (Redwood) — only after AP validation and milestone

If you can confirm AP validation ETA and whether we should route the invoice to accounts-payable@acmecorp.com or to Tom Hale, we'll schedule the invoice generation and aim for recognition in the Aug month close (if approvals come through by 8/18).

Attached: Acme_PO_4589.pdf (copy we received). I'll follow up with an internal checklist for finance so we don't overshoot the recognition cut.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Head of Revenue Operations
